description: April 9 birthday meaning: Aries decan 2, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 9 birthday falls in Aries, in the second decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Sun as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: Personality of an April 9 birthday
paragraphs: April 9 closes the Sun-ruled decan of Aries, around nineteen degrees into the sign, and carries the humanitarian 9. Fire and compassion together often read as an activist streak: the energy to start things, a desire for recognition and a genuine wish to make life better for people beyond one's own circle.

By noon UTC on April 9, the Sun has normally reached roughly 19° of Aries. That places the date in the Aries decan that astrologers give to Sun, the second of three. Between 10 and 19 degrees of Aries the Sun takes over as sub-ruler, lending this middle decan some of Leo's warmth and sense of occasion. The Martian drive is still there, yet it is often aimed at something worth being seen for: a cause, a team, a creative project with their name on it. Traditional writers associate this stretch with pride in the good sense, a wish to lead by example rather than by force. Generosity tends to come easily, and so can a sensitivity to being overlooked. A useful question for these Aries natives is whose applause actually matters, since chasing everyone's can scatter a strong fire.

sections.heading: Numerology of the April 9 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 9th, your birthday number is 9, the last and broadest of the single digits. Numerologists see the birth day as a secondary number that describes a natural gift. The 9 is traditionally associated with compassion, idealism and a wide view of humanity, perhaps because it contains something of every number before it. Those with this birthday often find themselves helping, teaching or creating for audiences beyond their own circle. Letting go can be a recurring theme for 9s, along with learning that finishing one chapter makes space for a better one.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same April 9 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 22 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: April 9 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 9 is the 99th day of the year (100th in a leap year). In most years Taurus season is under way by April 20, 11 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an April 9 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. April 9 is also the birthday of Charles Baudelaire (1821), Jean-Paul Belmondo (1933) and Kristen Stewart (1990).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 9?
faq.answer: April 9 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Aries, which tradition links with Sun.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 9?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 9 the Life Path is 2 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 22 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 9th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 9?
faq.answer: By April 9 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 9?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an April 9 birthday are Charles Baudelaire (1821), Jean-Paul Belmondo (1933) and Kristen Stewart (1990). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
